messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] p99 latency breach for customer Asterion (dedicated pool: asterion-euc-01) — p99 4.8s, baseline 1.9s over last 5m. Severity: P1. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/incidents/dedicated-latency

oncall-ryan: ack — I'm on it. Which metrics dashboard is best for the pool?

ops-lina: dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/asterion/asterion-euc-01?orgId=1 — p95 and p99 spiking from ~1.2s -> 3.5s and 1.9s -> 4.8s respectively. Request rate up ~2.8x.

sre-ana: quick scan: KV-cache hit rate for asterion-euc-01 dropped from 92% -> 55% in last 10m. Also spike in long-context (>=2048 tokens) requests from asterion-prod-frontend. Looks like cache churn + larger seq lengths.

oncall-ryan: noted. Any sign of noisy neighbor (another tenant) causing eviction?

sre-ana: yes — tenant_id T-993 has a sudden burst of multi-k prompt sequences. Tail latency correlates. Suggest: enable tenant_shield for asterion pool (soft isolate) + throttle T-993 concurrency to 2 while we investigate.

infra-bot: running command: ```redwoodctl pools patch --pool asterion-euc-01 --set tenant_shield=true```
infra-bot: command output: OK — tenant_shield=true applied to asterion-euc-01 (propagated to all nodes).

infra-bot: running throttle for tenant: ```redwoodctl tenants throttle --tenant T-993 --pool asterion-euc-01 --concurrency 2 --reason "emergency isolation"```
infra-bot: throttle result: SUCCESS — active sessions exceeding new concurrency will receive 429 until drained.

oncall-ryan: any immediate effect on p99?

ops-lina: small improvement visible — p99 down to 3.1s after shield+throttle. KV hit rate climbing back to 78%. Still room to stabilize.

pm-jordan: account team heads-up: we need to send a short customer note. @account-echo can you coordinate? Keep it proactive, say we're mitigating and will follow up.

account-echo: on it. Draft to Asterion: "We're seeing elevated latency on your dedicated pool in eu-central; we've isolated the noisy workload and applied safeguards. We're monitoring and will provide a timeline within 15 minutes." Will send after you confirm.

sre-ana: second mitigation: route a subset of requests to quantized model variant (model-qv2) for best-effort fallbacks to reduce per-token compute and KV pressure. Start canary at 5% traffic.

infra-bot: applying canary routing: ```redwoodctl routes set --pool asterion-euc-01 --route /v1/generate --fallback model-qv2 --canary 5%```
infra-bot: route update: OK. Canary live.

ops-lina: telemetry: after canary, p99 for canary path ~1.8s, overall p99 trending to 2.1s. User-facing error rate unchanged.

oncall-ryan: sounds reasonable. Plan: keep tenant_shield + throttle + canary for 30 minutes, monitor. If stable, stepdown throttles and remove canary carefully.

sre-ana: agreed. Postmortem action items: 1) increase KV cache allocation for asterion pool, 2) add per-tenant long-context soft-limits, 3) improve early-detection alert for KV-hit regressions, 4) run load replay to validate.

pm-jordan: thanks — @account-echo will update Asterion with the mitigation summary and ETA.

account-echo: message sent to Asterion ops: "Mitigation active, expected stabilization in 10-20min. We'll follow up with a root cause summary and timeline."

infra-bot: Note: fallback routing produced 5% canary traffic to model-qv2 — monitoring attached: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/asterion/canary-model-qv2

ops-lina: current numbers (5m rollup): p95 0.9s, p99 2.2s, KV hit 86%, TPS back to 1.1x baseline. Looks like mitigation is working.

oncall-ryan: I'll keep the pager open for another 40 minutes. If we hit >2.8s p99 again we re-escalate.

sre-ana: filing incident ticket and assigning follow-ups. Will own the postmortem.

incident-bot: [UPDATE] Alert status: mitigated -> monitoring. Close criteria: stable p99 < 2.5s for 30m and KV hit >80%.

account-echo: wrapping up with customer: they requested a brief call tomorrow if RCA indicates model usage pattern changes — scheduling.

ops-lina: final check at +30m: p99 1.95s, KV hit 89%, no new throttles triggered. Recommend we remove temporary throttle after 30m of stability.

infra-bot: removing tenant throttle: ```redwoodctl tenants throttle --tenant T-993 --pool asterion-euc-01 --remove```
infra-bot: remove result: SUCCESS.

oncall-ryan: thanks team — transitioning to follow-up mode. Good work. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: [RESOLVE] Incident resolved for asterion-euc-01. Incident ticket: INC-2023-8742. Postmortem assigned to sre-ana.
